title: Atomistic-Continuum Coupling by Homogenization
summary: Classical atomistic simulations based on interatomic potentials resolve lattice instabilities, defect nucleation, and microstructure evolution with high fidelity, but their accessible system sizes remain far below those required for micrometer-scale structural analyses. We develop a two-scale atomistic-continuum framework that couples a nonlinear finite-element boundary-value problem at the microscale to periodic molecular-statics cell problems at quadrature points.
